args.subject: Private dining table for 12 next Friday - Blue Sparrow Tech
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am writing from Blue Sparrow Tech. I would like to request a private dining table for 12 people next Friday.

Could you please let us know availability and any menu options for a group of our size? We are looking to book for a business dinner.

Please find our contact information below, and feel free to reach out if you need any further details.

Thank you,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
